responsibility: Declares the full public interface and core data structures of GCC’s language-independent diagnostics subsystem. It defines diagnostic_info and diagnostic_context, output-format and path-format enums, column and escape policies, callback hooks, location/prefix helpers, context initialization and reporting APIs, and formatting/query helpers that frontend, middle-end, and structured-output code use to construct, classify, and emit diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Public interface header within the diagnostic stem group: it declares diagnostic_context, diagnostic_info, enums, and reporting APIs used across GCC, whereas diagnostic.cc implements those facilities and diagnostic.def supplies the canonical diagnostic-kind table they are built from.
